personas.label: Laser/Plasma Job Shop - Head Crash Prevention

problems.summary: Tip-up slugs on slat beds cause catastrophic head crashes at 100+ m/min, destroying $12k-$25k laser heads and stopping production for days.

features.summary: Automated slat-bed geometry calculation and collision envelope verification with >12.5mm clearance across 52,400 tool vectors.
Automatic micro-tabbing, nano-joints, and smart lead-in/lead-out planning that physically prevent parts from tilting into the rapid-motion envelope.

personas.label: High-Alloy Aerospace/Medical Fab - Yield & Thermal Control

problems.summary: Titanium, 316L, and Inconel sheets cost hundreds of dollars; manual nesting wastes 15-30% and thermal distortion scraps parts.

features.summary: MaxRects 2D nesting with kerf compensation (G41/G42) to reach >90% sheet utilization and cut scrap by thousands per month.
Thermal TSP sequencing that spreads heat so you avoid warping and HAZ scrap without hand-editing G-code.

personas.label: Multi-Process CNC + Weld - Unified Stack & AI Copilots

problems.summary: Shops juggle 4-6 legacy tools and expensive post-processors; when senior machinists retire, juniors struggle to program safely.

features.summary: Zero-install cloud suite that merges CAD healing, multi-part nesting, 5-axis collision checking, and instant post-processing for all major CNC dialects.
In-app AI metallurgy and Rosenthal heat copilots that recommend laser power, assist gas, focal point, weld bead geometry, and ERP quoting.
